originals: Does an accepted molotov always force the violent ending?
Take the Molotov, then do only peaceful acts: still a violent riot?
entries.question: Take North's Molotov at the pavilion first, then do only peaceful actions until the sirens: is the ending MARKUS LED A VIOLENT RIOT (yes/no)?
entries.why: Only PowerPyx commenters (Jd: 75% peaceful meter yet riot; Ravyn Black: 'automatically gets you a riot') say so; the wiki footnote talks only of the 60% meter. Benchmark: TAKE always gives AGGRESSIVE MESSAGE.

originals: …When exactly is the molotov withheld ("enough peaceful actions")?
Tag one thing, then go to the pavilion: does North still offer the Molotov?
entries.question: Tag one object, then walk to the pavilion: does North still offer the Molotov (yes/no)?
entries.why: Wiki Note: 'if enough peaceful actions were chosen prior then North will not offer'; PowerPyx: go there 'first thing… (don't touch other objects yet)'. No count is given. Benchmark withholds it whenever the meter already reads at least 60% peaceful, so one tag withholds it.

originals: Meter between 40% and 60%?
Otherwise, when time runs out: PACIFIST MESSAGE if at least 60%…
entries.question: If the meter ends about 55% peaceful / 45% violent (no Molotov), which ending plays: PEACEFUL PROTEST, VIOLENT RIOT, or FAILED TO DELIVER?
entries.why: Wiki footnote: 'at least 60% on either side' for either message node; FAIL TO SEND needs no action at all (wiki footnote, PowerPyx). Nothing covers a balanced meter after actions. Benchmark counts anything under 60% peaceful as aggressive.

entries.topic: Valence of the ambiguous protest actions
originals: Ambiguous actions?
Each action moves the protest meter, which the game shows on screen…
entries.question: With the meter on screen, does FREE ANDROIDS IN SHOP WINDOWS push it toward violent, and does HACK BILLBOARDS (after a peaceful tower speech) push it toward violent (yes/no each)?
entries.why: BURN THE PLACE trophy lists 'Free androids' and 'Hijack screen' as violent; wiki Notes say shop windows can stay peaceful and billboards depend on the Stratford speech, and street lights/banner on the current ratio; OVERLOAD ELECTRIC SYSTEM has no source. Benchmark: shop windows, both billboard hacks, lights-off and overload violent; banner and hack lights peaceful.

entries.topic: Police scene after a failed message
originals: FAIL TO SEND A MESSAGE (a) does the police scene still follow?
…(c) Commenter vlido could not trigger it
entries.answer: Yes. In the template the 'Police arrives' block sits inside 'Send a message' after the timeout blocks, and only its first exchange is conditioned on pacifist/aggressive; the Chris prompt is unconditional. PowerPyx: 'You still need to finish the scene with the cops to end the chapter.' vlido's failure to trigger it is about game timing, which the benchmark models as two idle waits.
entries.source: template ch26 send-message / police-arrives; pp.txt 'Markus Failed to Deliver His Message'
